integrity: Self-contained analytic argument and independently run ordinary numerical/rational checker; numerical samples do not certify the infinite-dimensional limits; no claim of external review.
scientific_limitations: The exact Gaussian crosspolytope cone-angle identity and cube-section framework are prior work; the original contribution assessed is the two-term large-d minimal-vertex rarity and the conditional exponential coordinate profile. Historical priority provisional, especially because a plausible 2025 cube-slice manuscript was accessible only at abstract level. For central Haar cube sections only; no non-Haar or all-coordinate total-variation theorem.
title: Sharp rare-event law and conditional normal geometry for minimal central cube sections
